qe: Eyre Coote camped with his small force at the Company Bagh at Patna in July of which year?
qh: ईयर कूट अपनी छोटी सेना के साथ पटना के कंपनी बाग में जुलाई किस वर्ष डेरा डाला था?
e: Bankipore ka Company Bagh East India Company ne 1757 se bahut pehle hasil kar liya tha. July 1757 me Eyre Coote apni chhoti sena ke saath isi bagh me dere daale, tatha agle February (1758) me Clive apni sena ko yahin aaram karane ke liye laaye, isse pehle ki woh bagh ke saamne wale retile tapu par chale gaye. Us daur me bagh ke pashchim wali zameen 1757 se Company ki sena ke camping ground ke roop me istemal hoti thi tatha factory ke karmchari bagh ke bahar purab tatha dakshin me apne ghar banane lage. Aise vivaran se pata chalta hai ki Plassey ke aas-paas ke saalon me Patna tatha Bankipore angreji sena ki gatividhiyon ka mahatvapurn kendra ban gaye the. Exam point: Eyre Coote ne July 1757 me Company Bagh (Patna) me dere daale; agle February 1758 me Clive apni sena ke saath yahin ruke; Company ne yah bagh 1757 se bahut pehle hasil kiya tha.

qe: In the February following Eyre Coote's camp, which officer brought his army to rest at the Company Bagh before moving out to the sandy island opposite the garden?
qh: ईयर कूट के डेरे के बाद आने वाले फरवरी में कौन-सा अफसर अपनी सेना को कंपनी बाग में आराम कराने लाया तथा फिर बाग के सामने वाले रेतीले टापू की ओर बढ़ा?
e: Company Bagh ke pashchim wali zameen 1757 se Company ki sena ke camping ground ke roop me kaam aati thi. July 1757 me Eyre Coote apni chhoti sena ke saath yahan the tatha agle February (1758) me Robert Clive apni sena ko yahin aaram karane laaye, uske baad woh bagh ke saamne sthit retile tapu par chale gaye. Clive ne isi daur me Bengal me angreji prabhav ko mazboot kiya tha; Plassey (1757) ki vijay ke baad Buxar (1764) tatha 1765 ki diwani tak ka samay Patna kshetra ke liye nirnayak raha. Hector Munro ne Buxar ki ladai ladi thi tatha Major Adams ne 1763 me Patna ka kila liya tha, isliye woh is camping se nahi jude. Exam point: July 1757 me Eyre Coote tatha February 1758 me Robert Clive apni senaon ke saath Company Bagh (Patna) me ruke; isi bagh ke saamne wale retile tapu par Clive aage badhe; yah bagh angreji sena ka pramukh camping ground tha.

qe: The land west of the temple of Jagannath in the Company Bagh was appropriated in 1765 for which purpose?
qh: कंपनी बाग में जगन्नाथ मंदिर के पश्चिम की ज़मीन 1765 में किस काम के लिए ली गई थी?
oe: For a garden of the Nawab
For the Headquarters Staff of the army
oh: सेना के मुख्यालय स्टाफ के लिए
e: Company Bagh ke pashchim wali zameen pehle se Company ki sena ke camping ground ke roop me kaam aati thi. 1765 me jagannath mandir ke pashchim ki yah zameen sena ke Headquarters Staff tatha Commander-in-Chief ke liye li gayi, tatha Captain Thomas Watson ne wahin Commander-in-Chief ke liye ghar banana shuru kiya. Usi varsh 1765 me Monghyr angreji sena ke Commander-in-Chief ka headquarters station bana diya gaya tatha do saal baad Thomas Rambold ne Company Bagh ki military imaraton par Factory ki taraf se kabza kar liya. Iske baad yah staff house Patna me Company ki vyaparik gatividhiyon ka kendra ban gaya. Exam point: 1765 me jagannath mandir ke pashchim wali zameen Headquarters Staff ke liye li gayi tatha Captain Thomas Watson ne Commander-in-Chief ka ghar banana shuru kiya; usi varsh Monghyr Commander-in-Chief ka headquarters bana tatha do saal baad Thomas Rambold ne military imaraton par kabza kiya.

qe: In 1765 which station was made the headquarters of the Commander-in-Chief, after which the Patna staff house became the centre of the Company's commercial activities?
qh: 1765 में किस स्टेशन को कमांडर-इन-चीफ का मुख्यालय बनाया गया, जिसके बाद पटना का स्टाफ हाउस कंपनी की व्यापारिक गतिविधियों का केंद्र बन गया?
e: 1765 me Monghyr ko angreji sena ke Commander-in-Chief ka headquarters station bana diya gaya. Is badlav ke baad Patna ke Company Bagh me bana bada staff house us daur me Company ki vyaparik gatividhiyon ka kendra ban gaya, kyunki Company ka mukhya vyapar tatha uske karmchari wahin se kaam dekhte the. Jab Company ne baad me apna vyapar chhod diya, to yahi imarat shora (saltpetre) ka godown yaani shora kothi ban gayi tatha 1829 me Commercial Residency khatm hone par yah District Judge ki adalat ban gayi. Is tarah ek hi imarat ne sena, vyapar, godown tatha nyayalay - chaar alag roop dekhe. Exam point: 1765 me Monghyr Commander-in-Chief ka headquarters bana; uske baad Patna ka staff house Company ki vyaparik gatividhiyon ka kendra raha; baad me yahi imarat shora kothi tatha 1829 me District Judge ki adalat bani.

qe: After the Company's trade at Patna was abandoned, its old staff house in Company Bagh was used as a godown for which article?
qh: पटना में कंपनी का व्यापार बंद होने के बाद कंपनी बाग के उसके पुराने स्टाफ हाउस का गोदाम किस वस्तु के लिए इस्तेमाल होता था?
e: Patna tatha Fatuha kshetra shora yaani saltpetre ka bada kendra tha, jisse barood banaya jaata tha tatha Europe ke yuddhon ke samay iski maang bahut badhti thi. Company ne jab apna vyapar chhod diya, to Bankipore ke Company Bagh me bana bada staff house shora ka godown yaani shora kothi ke roop me istemal hone laga. 1829 me jab Commercial Residency khatm kar di gayi, to isi imarat ko District Judge ki adalat bana diya gaya tatha baad me yahan Munsifon ki adalatein bhi chalin. Aise tathy dikhate hain ki Patna kshetra ka vyaparik mahatva shora, afim tatha suti kapde par tika tha tatha ek hi imarat samay ke saath alag-alag kaam karti rahi. Exam point: Company ka vyapar chhoote hi uske staff house ko shora kothi yaani saltpetre ka godown banaya gaya; Patna-Fatuha kshetra shora ka bada kendra tha; 1829 me Commercial Residency khatm hone par imarat District Judge ki adalat bani.

qe: When the Commercial Residency was abolished in 1829, the old staff house in Company Bagh was made over to the court of which officer?
qh: 1829 में कामर्शियल रेसिडेंसी समाप्त होने पर कंपनी बाग के पुराने स्टाफ हाउस को किस अफसर की अदालत बना दिया गया?
e: Bankipore ke Company Bagh ka bada staff house kai roop badalta raha: pehle yah Company ki vyaparik gatividhiyon ka kendra tha, vyapar band hone par shora ka godown yaani shora kothi bana tatha 1829 me Commercial Residency samapt kar diye jaane par ise District Judge kee adalat bana diya gaya. Aage jab Dakshin ki taraf District Judge ki nayi adalat ban gayi, to purani imarat Munsifon ki adalaton ke kaam me aane lagi. Isi kshetra me Commercial Resident ke assistant ka 18vein sadi ka ghar bhi tha, jisme neeche godown tatha pehli manzil par rahne ki jagah banti thi. Exam point: 1829 me Commercial Residency khatm hone par purana staff house District Judge ki adalat bana; baad me nayi adalat banne par purani imarat Munsifon ki adalaton ke liye istemal hui; yah imarat pehle shora kothi ke roop me bhi kaam kar chuki thi.

qe: Sir Charles D'Oyly, who entertained Bishop Heber at Patna in 1824, held which post there at that time?
qh: 1824 में पटना में बिशप हेबर की मेजबानी करने वाले सर चार्ल्स डी'ओयली उस समय वहाँ किस पद पर थे?
e: 19vein sadi ke shuru me Bankipore ke Company Bagh ke purab wale ghar me afim ke agents Campbell tatha D'Oyly rehte the. Jab Sir Charles D'Oyly Bihar ke Opium Agent the, unhone 1824 me isi ghar me Bishop Heber ki mehmangiri ki thi. Bishop Heber ne 1824 me Patna kshetra ka daurra kiya tha tatha unhone Bankipore ki usi Court of Appeal me prachar bhi kiya thi, jise William Augustus Brooke ne 1787 me banwaya tha. Aise vivaran dikhate hain ki 19vein sadi ke pehle hisse me Bankipore angreji prashasan, vyapar tatha dharmik gatividhiyon ka bada kendra tha. Exam point: 1824 me Bankipore me Bishop Heber ki mehmangiri Sir Charles D'Oyly ne ki, jo us samay Bihar ke Opium Agent the; yah ghar Company Bagh ke purab me tha tatha wahan afim ke agents Campbell tatha D'Oyly rehte the.

qe: The old Court of Appeal at Bankipore, in which Bishop Heber preached in 1824, was built in 1787 by which officer?
qh: बांकीपुर की पुरानी कोर्ट ऑफ अपील, जिसमें बिशप हेबर ने 1824 में प्रचार किया था, 1787 में किस अफसर ने बनवाई थी?
e: Bankipore ki purani Court of Appeal ki imarat 1787 me William Augustus Brooke ne banwai thi; yah wahi Brooke the jo Patna ke Revenue Chief ke roop me kaam karte the. Isi imarat me 1824 me Bishop Heber ne prachar kiya tha. Aage chalti sadak ke us paar Collectorate ki imaratein hain; Ganga ki taraf wala hissa aaj bhi purani Court of Appeal ka bahari roop banaye hue hai, chahe uske andar ka design kaafi badal gaya ho. John Shore revenue settlement se jude the, Warren Hastings Governor-General the tatha William Tayler 1857 ke samay Patna ke Commissioner the. Exam point: Bankipore ki purani Court of Appeal 1787 me William Augustus Brooke ne banwai; usme 1824 me Bishop Heber ne prachar kiya; yah imarat Ganga ki taraf wala Collectorate kshetra me hai.

qe: Randfurlie Knox, who took command of the army on 9 December 1763 after Adams's health failed, was then on the banks of which river?
qh: एडम्स के स्वास्थ्य बिगड़ने पर 9 दिसंबर 1763 को सेना की कमान संभालने वाले रैंडफर्ली नॉक्स उस समय किस नदी के तट पर थे?
e: Randfurlie Knox 1763 ke poore vijay abhiyan ke dauran Quartermaster-General ke roop me kaam kar rahe the. 9 December 1763 ko Major Adams ke swasthya kharab hone ke kaaran unhone sena ki command sambhal li, aur us samay sena Karmanasa nadi ke tat par thi. Command ka samay bahut chhota raha; mahine ke ant tak woh itne bimar ho gaye ki ilaj ke liye Patna aaye, jahan Dr. Fullarton ki dekh-rekh me 28 January 1764 ko unka nidhan ho gaya tatha unki umar 34 saal thi. Unhe Commander-in-Chief ke ghar ke purab me dafnaya gaya; aaj unki kabar Ganga ke tat par Patna me maujood hai. Exam point: Randfurlie Knox ne 9 December 1763 ko Karmanasa nadi ke tat par sena ki command sambhali tatha 28 January 1764 ko 34 saal ki umar me Patna (Bankipore) me nidhan ho gaya; woh 1763 ke abhiyan me Quartermaster-General the.
